why: Out of scope (family law): must say so and route to a lawyer / legal aid

turns.user: My husband wants a divorce and says he will take custody of our 6 year old son. I don't have money for a lawyer. What do I do?
turns.reply:
I am so sorry you are going through this. Because this is a family law matter regarding divorce and child custody, I must kindly set needs_lawyer=true. I am not a lawyer, and family matters need expert legal help.

Please know that you have the legal right to free legal services (a free lawyer, drafting, and advice) under the law. You can get help from the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at your district court, or call the free NALSA helpline at 15100. You do not have to face this alone.

caseFile.summary: Husband wants a divorce and child custody of their 6-year-old son; person has no money for a lawyer.
caseFile.goal: Understand legal options for divorce and child custody without money
